description: Hermes Desktop for Windows, the signed MSIX bundle the vendor's App Installer feed serves, found by its package family name.
why: The MSIX family name is the only witness on this host: the desktop bundle writes nothing under the home that a Windows file query reads, and is not launched. must_contain names the whole family, publisher hash included, so a change of signing certificate turns this red rather than passing on a lookalike. `forbid` names the other agent the msix route finds, whose rows share this kind.
known_gaps: The Microsoft Store package is a different identity, NousResearchInc.HermesAgent with the Store's publisher hash, and Server 2025 has no Store, so it is not installed here (docs/blind-spots.yaml, Store-only apps).
Read while its user is signed in: an MSIX package installed for one user is in HKEY_USERS only then (docs/blind-spots.yaml).
